The problem

A soil-moisture-driven irrigation controller cutting campus landscaping water use by a third.

Why this project exists

Nadia H. and the team at Cairo University are building this as a electrical & electronics project, currently 49% of the way to a working result.

Objectives

  • → Reach a working prototype in Electrical & Electronics
  • → Document the build process as it happens, not after the fact
  • → Publish results the wider ForgeHub community can learn from
